name: Eldrazi Titan
description: A colossal, 150-foot-tall tentacled being, called a god by the surrakar, that drifts across the horizon and reduces the land to dust.

timeline.summary: A 150-foot-tall Eldrazi Titan appears on the horizon, draining color and life from the land.
timeline.quote: Mind-numbing, phantasmal, 150 feet tall ... a thing of madness.

timeline.summary: Gideon accepts that he cannot defeat the Titan and believes the surrakar spoke the truth about the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
timeline.quote: This was the chaos of the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
